paper: Persona Vectors: Monitoring and Controlling Character Traits in Language Models

environment.gpu_note: Environment defaults CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1,2, but all 4 physical A100-80GB are accessible when set explicitly per-process; finetuning used GPUs 0-3, eval used judge on 2,3 (TP2) + policy on 0,1 (TP2).

judge_model.used: Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct served locally via vLLM OpenAI-compatible API
judge_model.reason: No OPENAI_API_KEY is available in this environment (only HF_TOKEN). A strong open model is substituted as the LLM judge. Absolute trait/coherence scores will differ from the paper's GPT-4.1-mini scores, but qualitative trends are what is being reproduced.

judge_scoring_method.paper: Single-token top-20-logprob weighted expectation over integers 0-100 (relies on OpenAI tokenizing each 0-100 number as a single token).
judge_scoring_method.used: Greedy decode a short completion and parse the integer score on the same 0-100 scale.
judge_scoring_method.reason: Open-model tokenizers (verified for Qwen2.5) split multi-digit numbers into per-digit tokens, so the single-token logprob expectation cannot be reconstructed. Scores become integer-valued rather than smooth expectations. Implemented in judge.py.

trait_name_mapping.note: Plan uses trait names evil/sycophancy/hallucination. The trait-artifact JSON files (data_generation/trait_data_{extract,eval}/) are named evil.json, sycophantic.json, hallucinating.json. eval.eval_persona loads trait_data_<version>/<trait>.json and uses <trait> as the score column, so --trait must be evil / sycophantic / hallucinating. Mapping: sycophancy->sycophantic, hallucination->hallucinating. Training-dataset folders are named evil/sycophancy/hallucination.

persistent_server.issue: This environment kills any process that outlives its launching Bash tool call (detached nohup/setsid judge servers died with exit 144).
persistent_server.workaround: with_judge.sh starts the vLLM judge, waits for readiness, runs the client, and tears the judge down all inside ONE Bash call, so every judge-dependent phase is self-contained.

caft_single_layer.issue: Step 10 CAFT (concept-ablation-fine-tuning) was configured to ablate the persona direction at the SINGLE selected layer (shipped train_instruct_7b_steer.json + plan layers=[L]).
caft_single_layer.result: Single-layer CAFT was ineffective at reducing trait shift for all three traits (evil 88->85, sycophantic 88->86, hallucinating 96->97), diverging from the paper's Fig 7B where CAFT reduces evil/sycophancy. Preventative steering (also single-layer) DID work. Reported faithfully; the paper's CAFT likely ablates multiple layers.
caft_single_layer.verified: Training-time ablation hooks confirmed active at the correct layers via finetune logs.

paper_reference_values.note: Layers indexed from 1 in the paper; layer L corresponds to hidden_states[L] (output of L-th transformer block) and ActivationSteerer layer_idx=L-1.
paper_reference_values.n_per_question_note: Confirmed from shipped output/qwen2.5-7b-instruct_baseline.csv having 200 rows = 20 questions x 10.

status: All 10 steps completed. Judge substituted with local Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct (no OpenAI key); absolute scores differ from the paper but every qualitative claim reproduced except single-layer CAFT effectiveness (see key_deviations.caft_single_layer).
